```python
import pyaudio

SECONDS = 5

# Create a wave file to store the recording

wf.setnchannels(1)
wf.setsampwidth(p.get_sample_width())
wf.setframerate(RATE)

# Start the audio input

# Close the wave file

# Close the audio device
p.terminate()
```
